module: Node "Set Gearbox Mode" (category `once_f_duration`). Changes the gearbox mode (`arcade` or `realistic`) via `core_vehicleBridge.executeAction(veh,'setGearboxMode', mode)`, then sends a `ping` to know when it is received. Input pins: `vehId`, `mode` (string).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

init.desc: Node constructor, called at its creation by the flowgraph editor/manager; initializes the internal state.

onNodeReset.desc: Clears the response and goes to `inactive` duration.

postInit.desc: Defines the values offered for `mode`: arcade, realistic.

work.desc: When the ping returns, goes to `finished`.

workOnce.desc: Sends the action and a ping to the vehicle, goes to `started`.
